Subject: Community Roundtable — limited access promo codes for EduScale

Hi Ben / Monica,

We have a small invite-only roundtable with EduScale on 2026-10-07 (25 seats). They asked if we can provide 12 access promo codes that allow full trial access for the session registrants (to be redeemed in the week of the event). The audience is education engineers and product managers — high-value for our EDU GTM.

Ask: can Sales Ops issue a batch of 12 single-use promo codes (90-day trial credit) and one reserve demo code for the session host? If yes, please advise any constraints (expiration date, per-account limits) and I can share the redemption instructions to the EduScale marketing contact.

Attached: draft invite copy and the CSV template I use for code fulfillment.

Budget note: this is a partner-led co-hosted session; marketing will cover speaker expenses but we are approving promo credit out of PLG event budget. Tagged to HUBSPOT-OBJ-55672.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if you need details.

— Soojin

Thanks for the context — question for Monica on approver/budget. A couple of operational clarifications from Ops:
- We can generate single-use codes with a configurable expiry. Default expiry is 120d; can set to 30/60/90.
- Must confirm whether codes should be restricted to new accounts only or usable for top-ups on existing accounts.
- I will need the final attendee list at least 48 hours before distribution for audit tagging.

If Monica signs off on 12 + 1 reserve with 90d expiry and new-account restriction, I’ll create the CSV and upload to fulfillment queue.

Ben
Product Partnerships (Sales Ops)

Approved.

Notes: approve 12 single-use codes + 1 reserve demo code. Expiry: 90 days from issuance. Restriction: new-account only (so we don’t apply credits to existing paid accounts). Tag budget to "Partner Events — Q4 EDU".

Ben — proceed with generation and include the reserve code in a separate row labelled "HOST_DEMO". Please also paste the fulfillment record back into HubSpot (HUBSPOT-OBJ-55672) once uploaded.

Soojin — once codes are generated, please provide the redemption instructions and the final attendee CSV to Ava at EduScale. Keep marketing cc'd.

Subject: Promo codes and redemption instructions for EduScale roundtable — 2026-10-07

Hi Ava — great to lock this in. Per our conversation, please find the batch of single-use codes attached and the basic redemption steps below. We issued 12 attendee codes + 1 host demo code.

Attachments: promo_codes_batch.csv (format: code,expiry,restriction,notes)

Redemption steps for attendees:
1) Create a new account at app.redwood.com/signup (codes are new-account only).
2) After verifying email, go to Billing -> Apply Promo Code.
3) Enter the unique code; trial credits will apply instantly (90-day trial credit).

Host demo instructions: use the code labelled HOST_DEMO to provision a demo account for the session (no attendee restriction).

Important: codes expire 90 days after issuance. Please do not distribute beyond the confirmed invitees; we will audit redemptions post-event. We need final attendee list by 2026-10-05 09:00 PDT for tagging.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 10-minute walkthrough of the signup flow for your team next week.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
